defaultData.title: Quick Start Guide - Day One
defaultData.description: Learn the essential steps to survive and progress in the Addon.
defaultData.author: Addon Team

sections.title: Step 1: Gathering Basic Materials
sections.content: To begin harnessing Addon magic, locate **Stellar Crystal Ore** in the underground (Y < 16).

sections.title: Step 2: Constructing the Mystic Workstation
sections.content: Combine 4 Stellar Crystals with a standard Crafting Table to create the **Mystic Forge Workstation**.

sections.title: Step 3: Facing the First Boss
sections.content: With the **Stellar Sword** and full armor set, prepare to summon the Guardian at the Celestial Altar.
